rules: READ-ONLY evidence at a game tick. It is not a permit, not a decision and not proof the world is unchanged afterwards: a consumer about to act must re-observe and check freshness against the CURRENT game tick (fresh_until_tick).
outcome OK = the whole box was examined and every chunk in it was loaded. Only then does results == [] (proven_empty = true) mean 'none found'.

PARTIAL_UNLOADED = part of the box lies in unloaded chunks (skipped_unloaded, unloaded_chunks): absence there is UNKNOWN. PARTIAL_BUDGET = max_examined ran out; nearer columns were examined first. CANCELLED = interrupted, results withheld. REJECTED = invalid request, reject_code says why, nothing was read.
results are the nearest matches ordered by (distance squared, y, x, z); truncated = more matches existed than max_results. Chunks are never loaded or generated to answer a request.
reject_code and the request echo (center .. max_examined) are present only when they apply. The Forge binding observes around the named NPC's own block position.
